subject: Use `vpsrlq` instead of `vpshufd` in avx2/avx512 accumulate.
perf_evidence: Commit replaces a shuffle with a logical shift to relieve a measured SIMD port bottleneck.
change_summary: Rewrites AVX2/AVX512 XXH3 accumulate and scramble lane extraction with 64-bit logical shifts.

units.name: raw AVX2 and AVX512 one-stripe accumulate and scramble
units.evidence: Both changed raw functions pass bidirectional Alive2 for AVX2; the corresponding AVX512 functions also pass in r_avx512.

units.name: public XXH3 64/128-bit fixed 256/320-byte AVX2 and AVX512 cases
units.evidence: Five public cases pass both Alive2 directions under AVX2, and the same five pass under AVX512 in r_api_avx512.

units.name: public XXH3_64bits, 1088 bytes, path including accumulator scramble
units.evidence: AVX2 times out at 1088 bytes; AVX512 SMT runs out of memory. Both are inconclusive, not unsupported instruction semantics.

notes: Raw-step equivalence supports the change but is not promoted to an unchecked full-loop API proof. The old r_api_big_avx512 result.json calls solver memout UNSUPPORTED; METHOD.md and the corrected runner classify it UNKNOWN.
